description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG +30%, RES +25% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Black Magic Mode I (Onion Knight (Fire))] and [Black Magic Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Black Magic Mode I (Onion Knight (Fire))
description.text: Black Magic abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Black Magic abilities, casts Dual Flame Sorcery when removed

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Black Magic Mode II (Onion Knight (Fire))], removes [Dual Awoken Black Magic Mode I (Onion Knight (Fire))]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Black Magic Mode II (Onion Knight (Fire))
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Black Magic abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Dual Fire Magic after using Black Magic abilities

description.name: Dual Fire Magic
description.text: Six single attacks (1.98 each), grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies to all allies in the character's row

description.name: Dual Flame Sorcery
description.text: One single attack (15.25/16.92/18.61) capped at 99999 if the user dealt 0-72000/72001-240000/240001+ damage while under [Dual Awoken Black Magic Mode I (Onion Knight (Fire))]

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Black Magic Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Black Magic abilities deal 5% more damage
